author: Hannah Fry
description:
Let's be clear - carrots are still very good for you! Eat your vegetables, kids. 🥕🥕🥕

But the only way they could actually improve your vision is if you were severely Vitamin A deficient to begin with (which is incredibly unlikely). And even then, there are better vegetables than carrots:
Dietary sources of lutein and zeaxanthin carotenoids and their role in eye health by El-Sayed M Abdel-Aal, Humayoun Akhtar, Khalid Zaheer, and Rashida Ali (2013)🥬🥦

And of course, check out the World Carrot Museum - sadly no longer updating, but still delightful: 🧐
🥕www.carrotmuseum.co.uk🥕
title: Keep Calm and Carrot On
